summary_zh: 今日泰國焦點在環保稽查：普拉千武府一工廠被查出囤放逾1,200噸電子廢棄物並侵占森林保留區，居民發起1,300人連署要求關廠清運，顯示廢棄物與排放管控壓力升高，製造商需強化合規追蹤。另BOI支持豐田14.9億泰銖氫能Hilux投資案。
summary_en: Thailand: a Prachinburi factory was found storing 1,200+ tonnes of e-waste on forest reserve land, and residents are gathering 1,300 signatures to close it, signaling stricter environmental scrutiny. Separately, BOI backed Toyota's THB1.49bn hydrogen Hilux investment.
